requirements.general_text: Any of These: A-Level / STPM: ABB including A in Mathematics UEC: 8 points including A1 in Mathematics and Advanced Mathematics, A2 in English (5 subjects not less than B grade) ATAR (WACE/SACE): WACE: 90 including 80% in Mathematics Method / Specialist SACE: 90% including 17 in Mathematics Method / Specialist Canada Year 12 High School Diploma: CPU is not acceptable International Baccalaureate Diploma: 28 points with 6 in HL AA Mathematics (HL Analysis and Approaches Mathematics) Matriculation/Foundation: CGPA 3.5 (further assessment is required) Diploma: Diploma with CGPA 3.5 (further assessment is required) Foundation in Business / Foundation in Science (from Heriot-Watt University Malaysia): Grade C average including A in Mathematics and C in English SMA 3 (Indonesia): 8.0 including 8.0 in Mathematics Year 12 State Board High School Examination (India): 75% including 80% in Mathematics Senior High School Graduation Certificate (China): 80% including 80% in Mathematics Important Notes: Applications from individuals with a wide range of qualifications are encouraged. Eligibility is best determined by submitting a complete application with academic documents. Entry requirements are subject to change, and individual offers may vary. English Language Requirements: For Non-Native English Speakers: Evidence of English language ability is required. Minimum IELTS 6.5 (or equivalent) with no score lower than 6.0. English Language Courses: Offered for those who do not meet the IELTS 6.5 requirement.
